_doc: Market events — scheduled/random shocks that nudge specific goods/currencies and surface as ticker headlines (E1 local sim; E2 server broadcasts globally). Each event has a deterministic daily schedule slot (dayMod: fires when (dayEpoch % every)===offset), a target (good itemId or currency id), a signed magnitude (added to feedMult, bounded by the sim), a decay (ticks), and a localizable headline i18n key + EN default. Informative flavor + a numbers reason to trade — never pay-to-win. CDN-overridable.

events.headline: Coffee harvest is in — coffee dips.
Ferry strike at the docks — staples spike.
Fresh silver from the mines — the real firms up.
Prices double overnight — the mark tumbles again.
